svg.aria-label: Projects. Odofull (Personal · Solo · 2026): Scheduling app for independent dentists. It confirms appointments over WhatsApp and offers cancelled slots to the next patient automatically. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Supabase, WhatsApp Cloud API. GrandPrixTracker (UADE · Team of 4 · 2026, In progress): Booking platform for Formula 1 race packages. One atomic checkout covers hotel, tickets and flights, with live stock checks against a legacy SOAP system. Built with Java, Spring Boot, Next.js, PostgreSQL, Microservices, ETL. PoleBid (UADE · Team of 4 · 2026): Mobile app for real-time bidding at live auctions, built on top of an existing database with concurrency control so simultaneous bids stay consistent. Built with React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Supabase Realtime. F1 Driver DNA (UADE · Team of 4 · 2026): Data science system that compares F1 drivers across 70+ years, with a custom Elo rating that separates driver from car, and clusters drivers into archetypes. Built with Python, pandas, scikit-learn, UMAP, Streamlit. Earlier, 2025: FitBridge: Marketplace that connects clients with personal trainers: listings, booking, payments and scheduling. Built solo. Built with React, Node.js, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL. Sports matchmaking: Backend to publish and find pickup games, with matchmaking and notifications. I led a team of four. Built with Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL.
